trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is nothing extra to do for it: it is the receipt for finishing everything else in this guide, so chase it last and let it arrive on its own.
steps: Work through the six roadmap stages in order, story first and collectibles last.
Keep the checklist ticked as you go so nothing slips through.
When the 54th trophy pops, the platinum follows immediately.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Play through the intro, follow the on-screen prompts, and it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening sequence.
Follow the mission prompts until Gone Fishing completes.
No preparation or side content is needed first.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 is the opening stretch of the story. Play the story missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. While you are in Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude: it is the only confirmed missable trophy, so handle it now and keep a manual Chapter 1 save.
steps: Play every Chapter 1 story mission in order.
Before finishing the chapter, meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot for Positive Mental Attitude.
Keep a manual save from Chapter 1 as insurance.
Finish the chapter's final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 continues the story after Chapter 1. There is nothing missable here: play the missions in order and the trophy pops when the chapter closes.
steps: Start Chapter 2 after finishing Chapter 1.
Play the story missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 is the middle stretch of the story. Keep playing the missions in order; the trophy pops at the chapter's end and nothing in it can be missed.
steps: Start Chapter 3 after Chapter 2.
Play the story missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the late-story stretch before the finale. Play the missions in order and the trophy pops when the chapter ends.
steps: Start Chapter 4 after Chapter 3.
Play the story missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The final mission closes the story. Finish it and this gold pops. If you are hunting the platinum, do the finale after the Chapter 1 missable is safely banked, then move on to the side content.
steps: Finish Chapter 4 and start the final mission.
Play the finale through to its end.
The trophy pops on the mission complete screen.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a named story mission. Play it when it appears in the story flow and the trophy pops on completion.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops on the mission complete screen.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a named story heist mission. It is a longer set piece, so give it a full session; the trophy pops when the heist ends.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story.
Play the heist through to its end.
The trophy pops on the mission complete screen.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a named story mission. Play it when it appears and the trophy pops on completion.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops on the mission complete screen.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a named story mission. Play it through when it appears in the story flow; the trophy pops on completion.
steps: Reach Headliners in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops on the mission complete screen.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a named story mission at the airport. Play it when it appears and the trophy pops on completion.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops on the mission complete screen.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a named story mission. It is a longer combat set piece, so stock up before starting; the trophy pops when the operation ends.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Stock up on ammo and armour first.
Play the operation through to its end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: 100% completion is the game's own checklist: story, stranger strands, activities and collectibles. The in-game stats screen shows what is left. This trophy is the last grind before the platinum, so leave its final push until everything else is nearly done.
steps: Finish the story and the stranger strands first.
Open the in-game stats screen and note every unfinished category.
Clear the remaining activities and collectibles.
The trophy pops when the completion counter hits 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts count whenever you pull one off in free roam: jumps, near misses, airtime and drifts all feed the counter. The fastest way is a fast bike and the stunt jumps scattered around Leonida, chained in short sessions so it never feels like a grind.
steps: Grab a fast bike and head for the stunt jumps.
Chain jumps, airtime and near misses in free roam.
Check the stats screen to watch the counter climb toward 250.
Short sessions across several days beat one long slog.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Leonida is full of side activities: races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, drone races and more. This trophy just wants one go at each type, so treat it as a tour of the map rather than a grind.
steps: Open the activities list on the map and note the types you have not tried.
Visit each activity type once: a race, fishing, the range, an arcade game, bowling and the rest.
The trophy pops when the last untried type is done.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The Shooting Range runs 42 challenges (per the kit's own rules text), and every one needs a gold medal. This is the hardest skill trophy in the list: learn each challenge's rhythm, use the range's own weapons, and take them one at a time instead of marathoning the whole set.
steps: Go to a Shooting Range and open the challenge list.
Practice each challenge until you know its target pattern.
Earn gold on one challenge, then move to the next.
All 42 challenges at gold pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun runs drone races at several spots around Leonida, and you need a win at every one. Learn the racing line at each spot first, then go for the win; the drone handles the same everywhere, so one good run per location is enough.
steps: Find each Top Fun drone race location on the map.
Practice a location once to learn its course.
Win the race at that location, then move to the next.
A win at every location pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty different races, any mix of street, off-road and water events. Variety is the point: a race only counts once, so keep moving to new events instead of replaying your favourite.
steps: Open the race list and pick events you have not won yet.
Win each race once; replays of a won race do not count.
Mix street, off-road and water races to reach 20 different wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal runs the fishing challenges. Challenge him, out-fish him, and the trophy is yours. Use the best rod and bait you can buy first: the challenge is a straight contest of catch weight.
steps: Buy the best rod and bait available.
Find Cal and take his fishing challenge.
Out-fish him to win the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Any arcade cabinet, any game, one full playthrough. Pick the shortest game on the first cabinet you find and finish it.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Start any game and play it to its end.
The trophy pops when the game completes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the stranger contacts with a mission strand of his own. Play his missions in order until the strand ends; the trophy pops on his final mission.
steps: Find Andy and start his mission strand.
Play his missions in order.
Finish his final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand ends on the water. Play his missions in order until the final one, and the trophy pops when it ends.
steps: Find Kenton and start his mission strand.
Play his missions in order.
Finish his final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger strands are scattered across Leonida, marked with a question mark on the map. Each strand is a short chain of missions; finish all eight and the silver pops. Work through them alongside the story so they never pile up at the end.
steps: Follow the question-mark icons on the map to find stranger strands.
Play each strand's missions in order.
Finish all 8 strands to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand is a biker story. Play his missions in order until the final ride; the trophy pops when it ends.
steps: Find Billy and start his mission strand.
Play his missions in order.
Finish his final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand is a supply-running story. Play his missions in order until the last delivery; the trophy pops when it ends.
steps: Find Randy and start his mission strand.
Play his missions in order.
Finish his final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand ends his story arc. Play his missions in order until the final one; the trophy pops when it ends.
steps: Find Tyrone and start his mission strand.
Play his missions in order.
Finish his final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the only confirmed missable trophy in the game. Meditation spots are found across Leonida, and the Chapter 1 balcony spot can only be reached during Chapter 1, so do it before the chapter ends. COUNT UNCONFIRMED: 18 meditation spots is the reported total, not yet verified. Keep a manual Chapter 1 save until this pops.
steps: During Chapter 1, go to the balcony meditation spot and meditate there first.
Keep a manual save from Chapter 1 until the trophy pops.
Find and meditate at every other spot across Leonida.
The trophy pops at the last spot (COUNT UNCONFIRMED: 18 spots reported).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret wants a unique animal hunted. Take the hunt, track the animal through its territory, and take the shot cleanly. Bring a scoped rifle and go slow: spooking the animal wastes the trip.
steps: Find Bret and take the hunting job.
Follow the tracks to the unique animal's territory.
Take the shot cleanly to complete the hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden all over Leonida, grouped into sets. You need three full sets. COUNT UNCONFIRMED: 3 card sets is the reported requirement, not yet verified. Work set by set and tick off each card as you find it.
steps: Pick one card set and hunt its cards first.
Check each card off as you collect it.
Complete three full sets (COUNT UNCONFIRMED: 3 sets reported).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK spots are the game's photo-op locations: strike the pose at each one. COUNT UNCONFIRMED: 100 locations is the reported total, not yet verified. This is the longest collectible grind in the list, so do it in short sessions across the map, region by region.
steps: Work region by region across Leonida.
WAiNK at every spot you pass.
Keep a checklist so no region is left half done.
The trophy pops at the last spot (COUNT UNCONFIRMED: 100 locations reported).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's open-world checklist: feats of driving, shooting, flying and more. Fifty of them, any fifty, so pick the easy ones first and let the harder ones come naturally as you play.
steps: Open the challenges list and sort by the ones you are closest to.
Clear the easy challenges first.
Keep playing naturally and mop up the rest.
The trophy pops at the 50th completed challenge.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get to four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat dies. A fast car and a quiet corner of the map do the work: lose the cops, do not fight them.
steps: Build a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner with you.
Break line of sight in a fast car.
Stay hidden until the Wanted Level clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shops in a row, partner with you, Wanted Level kept the whole way. Pick three shops close together, hit them fast, and keep moving: the trick is speed, not firepower.
steps: Pick three shops close together on the map.
Rob the first, then drive straight to the second and third.
Keep your Wanted Level alive through all three.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Every new vehicle you get into counts toward 100 discovered. Variety is everything: steal, borrow and test-drive anything with wheels, wings or a hull, and check the stats screen to see how close you are.
steps: Get into every vehicle type you see: cars, bikes, boats, planes.
Variety counts: a new model is a new discovery.
Check the stats screen to track progress toward 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time: trigger it with five enemies in view and drop all five before it ends. Find a busy shootout, wait for the group to cluster, then trigger it and work fast.
steps: Find a shootout with at least five enemies grouped up.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Take down all five before the focus ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: VCIA is the airport. Get airside, grab a plane, and leave without a flight plan. Any runway departure in a stolen plane does it.
steps: Get into VCIA airport.
Find a plane on the tarmac.
Take off without a scheduled flight.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhino is the tank. Get into one and cause the chaos the description hints at: the trophy is about driving the Rhino and surviving the heat it brings.
steps: Find a Rhino tank.
Drive it and stir up trouble.
Survive the response until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A clean jewelry job: in and out with no alarm and no witness. Go at a quiet hour, move slowly, take the goods and leave before anyone notices.
steps: Pick a quiet hour for the job.
Enter the jewelry store and move slowly.
Take the goods and leave undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five bank vaults, each robbed and escaped cleanly. Plan the getaway before the job, not after: a fast car parked close by matters more than the vault itself.
steps: Scout a bank and park a fast getaway car nearby.
Rob the vault.
Escape cleanly, then repeat at four more banks.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks run set routes around the city. Block one, crack it open, grab the cash and get clear before the response arrives.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it and crack it open.
Grab the cash and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Leonida is a whole state: every district, beach, swamp and backroad counts. COUNT UNCONFIRMED: 52 Leonida areas is the reported total, not yet verified. Drive the map edge to edge and the trophy pops when the last area is visited.
steps: Drive every road and region of the map.
Visit beaches, swamps, towns and the city itself.
The trophy pops when the last area is explored (COUNT UNCONFIRMED: 52 areas reported).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Every gang runs illegal operations around Leonida. Hit one operation per gang: learn which gang holds which spot, rob it, and move to the next gang's turf.
steps: Learn which gang runs each illegal operation.
Rob one operation for the first gang.
Repeat until every gang's operation has been hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet story moment on Ocean Beach: order a cocktail and enjoy the view. It pops during a story beat, so just play the scene when it comes.
steps: Reach the Ocean Beach story beat.
Order the cocktail and take in the view.
The trophy pops with the scene.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive into a vehicle showroom and smash your way back out through the glass, classic style. Any showroom, any fast car: the exit is the point.
steps: Pick a vehicle showroom and a fast car.
Drive in through the front.
Smash back out through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is the venue. Bowl a game there with a proper follow-through and the trophy pops.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a game.
The trophy pops on a good follow-through.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership trophy tied to doing something with mass appeal alongside your partner. Play the moment with your partner when it comes up in the story and the trophy follows.
steps: Reach the partnership moment with your partner.
Play it through together.
The trophy pops when the moment lands.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A story choice trophy: make the choice when the game offers it and the trophy pops either way. There is no wrong answer, only the one you pick.
steps: Reach the choice in the story.
Make your choice.
The trophy pops whatever you pick.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A story beat where the second attempt is the one that lands. Play the scene, fail or succeed the first time, and the trophy pops on the second go.
steps: Reach the scene in the story.
Play it through; the second attempt is the charm.
The trophy pops when it lands.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A strange encounter out in Leonida, the kind the game hides off the main path. Follow the oddity when you find it and the trophy pops when the scene plays out.
steps: Explore off the main path until you find the strange encounter.
Follow the scene through.
The trophy pops when it plays out.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by that bowls people over like pins. Get a vehicle, get a melee weapon ready, and sweep through a group at speed.
steps: Get a vehicle and a melee weapon.
Find a group on foot.
Drive by and bowl them over with the melee swing.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from jobs and heists; your contacts launder them into clean cash. Feed the bills through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It accumulates across the whole game, so keep laundering as you earn.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from jobs and heists.
Launder them through your contacts.
Keep going until $250,000 is clean.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the shops of Leonida: clothes, weapons, cars, food, anything. It accumulates over the whole game, so just keep buying what you need and it pops on its own.
steps: Buy gear, clothes, cars and supplies as you play.
Spending counts across every shop type.
The trophy pops when total spending hits $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Garage properties are for sale around Leonida. Buy every one of them: check the property listings on the map and work through them as your cash allows.
steps: Open the property listings and note every garage for sale.
Buy them one at a time as cash allows.
The trophy pops when the last garage is yours.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles. Register ten different ones: drive each to the app's pickup point and log it, then move to the next.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register a vehicle, then find another.
Repeat until 10 vehicles are registered.
